description: This file defines a controller class 'PaymentMethod' in the Opencart e-commerce framework, implementing API endpoints to select and retrieve available payment methods during checkout. It handles validation of customer data, cart contents, shipping, and payment addresses, and interacts with models for payment methods.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for managing and retrieving payment methods during checkout, including validation and response formatting.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the process of setting the selected payment method after validating customer data, cart contents, shipping, and payment address.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available payment methods for the current session after performing necessary validations.
